task: Preserve the exact nested parent proof/persistence exception at the release executor machine-error boundary so a blocked parent closure reports both the stable blocker code and its exact root cause without changing fail-closed semantics.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Release Unit Execution #260 (`37731330506`) successfully closed U03 through the governed ALREADY_APPLIED no-code path and advanced the parent to closureEligible=true / TRUTH_GATE, but parent closure then failed outwardly only as RELEASE_PARENT_PROOF_OR_PERSISTENCE_FAILED. `closeParentReleaseExecution()` already preserves the exact inner exception in `result.error`; `scripts/release-unit-execute.mjs` discards it whenever `result.reason` exists by serializing `result.reason ?? result.error`. This reproduces open Failure Intake #1018 (TRUSTED_EXECUTOR_EXCEPTION_LOG_ONLY) and violates the hardening requirement that authoritative gates/executors expose exact machine-readable root cause without a second log/API hunt.
observableOutcomes: A BLOCK result from the release executor emits a machine-readable payload containing the stable `reason` and the exact nested `error` simultaneously when both exist.
Existing blocker code semantics remain unchanged; diagnostic enrichment cannot convert BLOCK into PENDING/PASS or alter release-state transitions.
Parent proof/persistence failures continue to fail closed but expose the exact child command/guard exception directly in the workflow error.
Regression coverage proves generic reason-only, error-only and reason+error payload behavior without importing or executing the CLI driver.
Post-merge immutable source replay resumes from canonical state with U03 already CLOSED and reveals the exact remaining parent closure root cause directly.
unresolvedRisks: Replacing the stable blocker reason with only a raw exception would make automation brittle and lose the normalized failure class.
Serializing arbitrary result objects could leak unrelated state or secrets; only reason and error may be surfaced.
Changing parent closure proof behavior in the same transaction would conflate observability hardening with the still-unknown root-cause repair.
Editing persisted rehearsal state manually would invalidate resumability proof.

in: Add a minimal pure diagnostic payload formatter at the release executor boundary.
Serialize both normalized reason and exact nested error for BLOCK decisions.
Add regression tests for reason+error, reason-only and error-only payload shapes.
Preserve the existing parent helper, closure proof, Truth, persistence and CAS semantics.
out: No change to release-unit state-machine transitions.
No change to scripts/release-unit-parent-close.mjs proof or persistence behavior.
No change to immutable source branch/SHA.
No threshold, Truth, Sentinel, risk, lifecycle or receipt relaxation.
No storefront, template, Supabase or deployment change.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This is an observability-only change on a write-capable release executor. It must expose exact failure detail while preserving the stable blocker class, fail-closed behavior, state CAS semantics and least-privilege execution surface.

acceptanceCriteria: BLOCK with `{reason:'R',error:'E'}` produces a machine error that contains both `reason:'R'` and `error:'E'`.
BLOCK with reason only preserves the normalized reason and emits null/absent exact error deterministically.
BLOCK with error only preserves the exact error and emits null/absent normalized reason deterministically.
The executor still throws and exits non-zero for every BLOCK.
No release-state, parent proof, persistence, Truth or lifecycle semantics change.
Exact-head CI and lifecycle closure pass before merge.
Post-merge replay of immutable source `65e52ffd...` exposes the exact parent closure root cause without separate log hunting.
invariants: Stable blocker reason remains available to machine consumers.
Exact nested error is additive diagnostic evidence, not authority.
No secrets or whole result/state object are serialized.
Persisted release-state remains executor-owned and CAS-protected.
U03 remains CLOSED and is not reopened or duplicated.

parent state already closureEligible with activeUnitId null

requirements.requirement: Every fail-closed release executor BLOCK must retain its normalized reason and surface the exact nested authoritative error when present, without changing transition semantics or exposing unrelated state.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A normalized BLOCK reason may not mask an available exact nested executor error.
Diagnostic enrichment may not change BLOCK to PENDING/PASS or alter state persistence.
The diagnostic boundary may not serialize complete state/result/environment objects.

requirements.requirement: Parent closure remains bound to final implementation main and existing Completion Truth/Lifecycle authorities while observability is improved.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No diagnostic change may bypass or weaken parent Completion Truth, lifecycle, exact-main or persistence requirements.

notes: Live state after Release Unit Execution #260: U03 is CLOSED, materialization status ALREADY_APPLIED, verification VERIFIED/LEARN, noCode=true close receipt PASS; parent activeUnitId=null, closureEligible=true, closureComplete=false, lifecyclePhase=TRUTH_GATE. #260 then failed only as RELEASE_PARENT_PROOF_OR_PERSISTENCE_FAILED because the outer executor masks the exact `result.error` whenever `result.reason` exists.
